digest.component_or_area: CLI reference generation and registry contracts
propositions: CLI reference documentation and command help must be derived solely from runtime parser artifacts and registry enumeration, with --check modes validating byte-identical committed state
All manual command census sources including INTERCEPT_COMMANDS, regex parsing of intercepts, and hand-maintained option tables must be removed and replaced with registry enumeration
Test suites for help coverage, argparse routing, and exit codes must enumerate route classes directly from the registry rather than reconstructing policy sets
A clean no-extras distribution wheel must render all approved help forms with exact committed bytes without triggering operation, config, store, parser, or handler imports
Editorial documentation must be structurally separated from generated syntax sections and linted for top-level command spelling validity while never overriding generated content
The same verification commands must execute identically in local environments and CI, with rebar-mcp tested as a separate entry point with observable --help output
